freeze_status: Implementation settings frozen before donor-gate results and before aggregate recipient-outcome modeling; target paper, file schema, and isolated example rows had been inspected.
rank_transform: For every split and feature column, use the labeled training empirical CDF for both training and evaluation rows. Evaluation feature values do not alter the transform.
missing_descriptor_policy: Replace calculated-descriptor missing values with the labeled training median for that split; if an entire training column is missing, replace it with zero.

negative_controls.shuffle: Permute each donor-feature column independently within training and within evaluation, using fixed outcome-independent seeds.
negative_controls.gaussian: Generate the same number of independent standard-normal columns as the admitted donor vector, separately for training and evaluation with fixed seeds.

feature_form_selection: At budget 60, choose raw or rank using the lower mean RMSE of target_structure_plus_donor across the 100 frozen draws; ties choose raw.
claim_guard: Passing this gate permits one locked blind evaluation. It is not evidence of blind-set benefit and cannot establish a transferable edge by itself.
